findings.title: SQL built with string interpolation passed to execute()
findings.evidence: cur.execute(f"SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE name = '{name}'")
findings.recommendation: Use a parameterized query: keep the SQL text static with placeholders and pass the values as the second argument (sqlite3 uses '?', most other DB-API drivers use '%s'). Never interpolate request data into SQL text.

fix.before: cur.execute(f"SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE name = '{name}'")
fix.after: cur.execute('SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE name = %s', (name,))

findings.title: Dynamically built SQL variable 'query' passed to execute()
findings.evidence: L13: query = "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = " + str(user_id)  ->  L15: cur.execute(query)
findings.recommendation: Use a parameterized query: keep the SQL text static with placeholders and pass the values as the second argument (sqlite3 uses '?', most other DB-API drivers use '%s'). Never interpolate request data into SQL text.

fix.before:
query = "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = " + str(user_id)
cur.execute(query)
fix.after:
query = 'DELETE FROM users WHERE id = %s'
cur.execute(query, (str(user_id),))
